plan.notes: Official 2026-2027 undergraduate catalog curriculum (catalog.iit.edu). Eight-semester curriculum as published; semester totals 16/17/15/17/17/16/16/16 = 130, within the official 130-133 range. Range rows transcribed at the low end (professional ECE electives 3 SH where shown 3-4). The Major Design Experience (M) elective counts toward the 17-20 SH professional ECE elective requirement per the catalog footnote. Elective slots transcribed as choice slots with the catalog's own wording. ABET-accredited program.
